body:
In zed 1.15 preview devcontainers stopped working when i have 

```
    "postStartCommand": "git config --global credential.helper 'store --file ~/.git-credentials'"
```
in devcontainer.json


# Objective

- fix devcontainers


## Solution

- Single-quote each argument in `command_to_shell_string` so embedded commands
keep their original argv boundaries when the marker script's shell parses them.
For the Docker exec path, pass bare scripts through unquoted while quoting
commands with arguments to prevent re-interpretation of shell metacharacters.

## Testing

- Did not test my changes
- I am on Linux Wayland
